svg.title: How a task ends at the ambassador
svg.desc: A core agent opens a task. The ambassador checks policy and admission, journals its intent and sends the command to the courier system. The task ends in one of four ways: the courier answers and the outcome is succeeded, policy refuses it (or the waiting room is full) and it is rejected, no answer comes and the outcome is unknown with the resource held, or the ambassador asks the courier by operation id and finds the answer. ask: admitted, intent journalled: Core agent → Policy and admission → Ambassador → Journal. succeeded: the courier answers: Ambassador → Courier system → Ambassador → Core agent. rejected: policy refuses, or the room is full: Core agent → Policy and admission, refused at Policy and admission. sent, no answer comes: Ambassador → Courier system. unknown: held, told with no fallback: Ambassador → Held resources, Core agent. or asked by operation id: succeeded: Ambassador → Courier system → Ambassador → Core agent.

g.text: refuse before crossing, limit the load
ask: admitted, intent journalled: Core agent → Policy and admission → Ambassador → Journal
succeeded: the courier answers: Ambassador → Courier system → Ambassador → Core agent
rejected: policy refuses, or the room is full: Core agent → Policy and admission, refused at Policy and admission
sent, no answer comes: Ambassador → Courier system
unknown: held, told with no fallback: Ambassador → Held resources, Core agent
or asked by operation id: succeeded: Ambassador → Courier system → Ambassador → Core agent
